item.title: ⚓️ Arctic mission: detachment of Northern Fleet enters Laptev Sea A detachment of combat ships and supply vessels of the Northern Fleet, as part of the Arctic mission, passed throu
item.description: ⚓️ Arctic mission: detachment of Northern Fleet enters Laptev Sea A detachment of combat ships and supply vessels of the Northern Fleet, as part of the Arctic mission, passed through the Strait of Vilkitskiy, where it conducted ice reconnaissance on the route with the help of a Ka-29 helicopter and a UAV, and entered the Laptev Sea. 🗺 The detachment is now advancing on a given course and intensively maintains radio communication with ships on the Northern Sea Route to ensure their safety along the route. 🌊 There will be hard work: in the Laptev Sea, sailors of the Northern Fleet will continue to monitor the ice situation. The monitoring of the situation here is an important task on which both the success of the mission and the defence of Russia's interests in the Arctic depend. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29320

⚓️
Arctic mission: detachment of Northern Fleet enters Laptev Sea
A detachment of combat ships and supply vessels of the Northern Fleet, as part of the Arctic mission, passed through the Strait of Vilkitskiy, where it conducted ice reconnaissance on the route with the help of a Ka-29 helicopter and a UAV, and entered the Laptev Sea.
🗺
The detachment is now advancing on a given course and intensively maintains radio communication with ships on the Northern Sea Route to ensure their safety along the route.
🌊
There will be hard work:
in the Laptev Sea, sailors of the Northern Fleet will continue to monitor the ice situation. The monitoring of the situation here is an important task on which both the success of the mission and the defence of Russia's interests in the Arctic depend.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.content:encoded:

🎖
🎖
by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation
as of 10 September 2026
Part 2 (
👉
see
Part 1

📍
The Tsentr Group's units improved the tactical situation.
The Group's units engaged manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, an assault regiment of the AFU, the Azov special forces brigade, and four national guard brigades close to Andreyevka, Svyatogorovka, Belozherskoye, Novovodyanoye, Dobropolye, and Novotroitskoye of the Donetsk People's Republic.
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 415 troops, five armoured fighting vehicles, nine motor vehicles, one field artillery gun, and one electronic warfare station.
↗️
The Vostok Group's units advanced to the depth of the enemy's defence.
The Group's units inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade, an assault brigade, two air assault brigades, and two assault regiments of the AFU near Mechetnoye, Podgavrilovka (Dnepropetrovsk region), Vasilkovoye, Vasinovka, Omelnik, and Chervony Yar (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 360 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, and six motor vehicles.
💥
The Dnepr Group's units inflicted losses on
manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade and a mountain assault brigade of the AFU near Yulyevka, Kushugum, and Grigorovka (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
More than 50 troops and 14 motor vehicles of the enemy were neutralised.
✈️
Operational-tactical aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Russian Groups of Forces inflicted damage on
the Ukrainian transport and logistics infrastructure, used by the AFU, storage areas of UAVs and their components, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in 146 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
six guided aerial bombs, seven U.S.-made HIMARS MLRS projectiles, one Neptune long-range cruise missile, and 1,030 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.
⚓️
The Black Sea Fleet eliminated
three uncrewed surface vehicles of the AFU.
📊

since the beginning of the special military operation, the enemy
has lost:

30,879
tanks and other armoured fighting vehicles,
▫️
1,777
MLRS combat vehicles,
▫️
36,415
field artillery guns and mortars,
▫️
71,521
special military vehicles.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🚩 The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29315

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
🚩
Units of the Sever Group of Forces
have taken control over Zarubinka in Kharkov region
as a result of intensive actions to expand the control zone on the outer ring of the encirclement of the enemy's formations in Kharkov region.
▫️
Units of two enemy battalions
of up to 180 troops
have been blocked
near Olkhovatka of Kharkov region. AFU units have been hit inside the 'pocket' close to Malaya Volchya and Buzovo of Kharkov region.
▫️
All attempts to break through the encirclement have been thwarted.
▪️
During the day, the enemy losses amounted to up to 40 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, three pickup trucks, two ATVs, and three unmanned ground vehicles.
🚩
In the course of resolute assault actions, units of the Sever Group of Forces
took control over the settlement of Goptovka
in Kharkov region.
▪️
The Group's units inflicted losses on the formations of a mechanised brigade, two motorised infantry brigades of the AFU, a territorial defence brigade, and a national guard brigade near Lozovaya, Shevchenkovo, Novoaleksandrovka, and Annopolye in Kharkov region.
📍
In Sumy region, losses were inflicted on
manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade of the AFU and two territorial defence brigades close to Volnaya Sloboda, Esman, Semenovka, and Doroshovka (Sumy region).
▪️
In total, the enemy lost up to 230 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, 18 motor vehicles, one field artillery gun, and one electronic warfare station in the area of responsibility of the Sever Group of Forces.
📍
The Zapad Group's units took more advantageous lines and positions.
Russian elements inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades of the AFU, a marine brigade, and a territorial defence brigade close to Kovalevka, Vyssheye Solenoye, Chervony Oskol, Osinovo (Kharkov region), Krymki, Rubtsy, and Mayaki (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy losses amounted to more than 215 troops, one U.S.-made HMMWV armoured vehicle, 18 motor vehicles, one field artillery gun, and one U.S.-made AN/TPQ-50 counter-fire radar station.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation along the front line.
The Group's units hit formations of two mechanised brigades, an airmobile brigade, and a mountain assault brigade of the AFU near Slavyansk, Orekhovatka, Kramatorsk, Belenkoye, Klinovoye, Shabelkovka, Nikolayevka, Krasny Molochar, and Druzhkovka of the Donetsk People's Republic.
▪️
The enemy lost more than 160 troops, two Butsefal armoured personnel carriers, two armoured fighting vehicles, 19 motor vehicles, two field artillery guns, and one MLRS combat vehicle.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
